# LithGeek Custom Gaming Computers

> Local Lithgow tech shop specializing in custom gaming PC builds, computer repairs, and tabletop gaming community events.

LithGeek is a Blue Mountains-based computer retailer offering custom gaming PC builds with case modifications, comprehensive repair services for Windows/Mac/Linux systems, and community engagement through Warhammer 40K events. The shop serves the Lithgow, Katoomba, and Oberon regions with personalized tech consultation and support.
